# S2 does not compute distances over the WGS84 spheroid.

SELECT ST_DISTANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 0), TRUE)
=> error contains: The emulator does not support use_spheroid

# A GEOGRAPHY is text in DuckDB, so functions that would read it as a STRING are unsupported.

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2))
=> error contains: The emulator does not support function TO_JSON_STRING with GEOGRAPHY

# The emulator holds no full polygon, which ST_MAKEPOLYGON makes of an empty geography.

SELECT ST_MAKEPOLYGON(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING EMPTY'))
=> error contains: The emulator does not support ST_MAKEPOLYGON of an empty GEOGRAPHY

# BigQuery adds vertices to the GeoJSON of a line or a polygon, and the emulator writes only a point's.

SELECT ST_ASGEOJSON(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 2, 3 4)'))
=> error contains: The emulator does not support ST_ASGEOJSON of a LINESTRING

SELECT ST_ASGEOJSON(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 1 0, 0 1, 0 0))'))
=> error contains: The emulator does not support ST_ASGEOJSON of a POLYGON

SELECT ST_ASGEOJSON(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('MULTIPOINT(1 2, 3 4)'))
=> error contains: The emulator does not support ST_ASGEOJSON of a MULTIPOINT

# Eight octants cover the sphere; the emulator cannot represent the full polygon.

SELECT ST_UNION([ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 90 0, 0 90, 0 0))'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((90 0, 180 0, 0 90, 90 0))'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((180 0, -90 0, 0 90, 180 0))'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((-90 0, 0 0, 0 90, -90 0))'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 90 0, 0 -90, 0 0))'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((90 0, 180 0, 0 -90, 90 0))'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((180 0, -90 0, 0 -90, 180 0))'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((-90 0, 0 0, 0 -90, -90 0))')])
=> error contains: The emulator does not support ST_UNION producing the full polygon
